title: Glass Blanks on Order
summary: Hugh Lensley says Bettany Marlowe has an order for 3 glass blanks that cannot wait. The stock is at the glass kiln, and the deadline is before the next firing.
offer_text: "Bettany Marlowe has an order and nobody to fetch it. Hear Bettany out, then bring the goods from the glass kiln before the next firing. I will vouch for you."

objectives.text: Take 3 glass blanks from the glass kiln
Hand the glass blanks to Bettany Marlowe
